name: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine to FMN
summary: A 13-step route from S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine to FMN(3−), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

enzymes.name: anaerobic magnesium-protoporphyrin IX monomethyl ester cyclase

reactions.name: (-)-pluviatolide synthase
reactions.equation: (-)-matairesinol + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = (-)-pluviatolide + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + 2 H2O + H(+)

reactions.name: bursehernin 5'-monooxygenase
reactions.equation: (-)-bursehernin + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = (-)-5'-demethylyatein + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O + H(+)

reactions.name: (-)-deoxypodophyllotoxin + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = (-)-4'-desmeth...
reactions.equation: (-)-deoxypodophyllotoxin + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = (-)-4'-desmethyl-deoxypodophyllotoxin + formaldehyde + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O + H(+)

reactions.name: (-)-4'-demethyl-deoxypodophyllotoxin 4-hydroxylase
reactions.equation: (-)-4'-desmethyl-deoxypodophyllotoxin + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = 4'-demethylepipodophyllotoxin + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O + H(+)
